description: This file is a shell script (.sh) that automates the creation and configuration of UBI images for embedded systems. It defines functions for setting up UBI volumes, layouts, and parameters, and processes command-line arguments to generate a configuration and invoke the 'ubinize' tool.

methods.name: ubivol
methods.description: Defines a UBI volume with specific parameters such as name, image, size, and type.

methods.name: ubilayout
methods.description: Sets up the layout of UBI volumes based on provided parts, including root filesystem and kernel images.

methods.name: set_ubinize_seq
methods.description: Configures the sequence parameter for ubinize based on the SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH environment variable.
